g55_move_a_model_plus_deadline_move_v_ba.classification_evidence: Fitted grade with season-block bootstrap; no refuted mechanism and no positive-control bound, so recorded below power with probability_positive.
g55_move_a_model_plus_deadline_move_v_ba.description: one fitted probability: served-base model logit plus the opener-to-close line move (zeroed on Sunday-night and Monday games, whose close comes after the pool deadline), leave-one-season-out logistic, minus base model alone, at the Tuesday opener; record 832-671 v 802-701; log loss 0.6873 v 0.6968; move-only control 804-699
g55_move_a_model_plus_deadline_move_v_ba.notes: POST-HOC: 7 hard follow-rule looks were read before these 4 fitted arms (A model+move, B who-plays+move, C sign of move, D move only); 11 looks in family g55_move_combined. The move term already serves in the pick probability (MKT-16); A re-measures it on the 2020-25 model-alone population. Late-game moves zeroed because the close comes after the pool deadline.
g55_move_a_model_plus_deadline_move_v_ba.plain_summary: Feeds the model how far the betting line moved between Tuesday and our pick deadline, as one more input to the same probability.
